title: Systems Not Goals
hook: Everyone has the same goal. The difference is who actually built something that gets them there.
statement: Goals give you a direction. Systems are what actually get you there.
explainer: Staring at a goal doesn't move it. A decent system you run every day will beat a perfect one you only run when you feel like it.
sop: Take one goal and write the daily system that would produce it.
Score System Quality and Consistency 1 to 10.
Track only whether you ran the system today.
Check the outcome monthly, not daily.
After 90 days with no movement, redesign the system instead of pushing harder.
equation_example: System Quality 6, Consistency 9. 6 × 9 = 54 out of 100. Higher means a solid system run steadily. A great system with low consistency means you built something good and then walked away from it.
question: Write down one goal and the daily system that would get you there.
closing_statement: Build the system before you chase the goal.
caption:
Principle Nº 108: Systems Not Goals

Everyone has the same goal. The difference is who actually built something that gets them there.

Goals give you a direction. Systems are what actually get you there.

Your turn: Write down one goal and the daily system that would get you there.
